narrative.overview: Every page is a note of value printed in intaglio: deep navy plates laid on cool security paper, engraved with guilloche work that a forger could not reproduce. The firm's promise (every figure in its place) is shown as craft rather than claimed. Precision is the luxury: hairline strokes, tabular figures, engraved display type, and nothing decorative that does not belong to the world of banknotes, bond coupons and share certificates.
keyCharacteristics: Navy intaglio notes framed by a 1px inner rule, alternating with cool paper (never cream).
Generative guilloche: rosettes and braided bands drawn as true hairlines, at about 0.8px at any size.
Bodoni Moda engraved display over Archivo, with wide 125% tracked caps for legends.
Tabular serial numerals for every date, hour, rate and phone number.
Photography only as navy duotone engraved vignettes in oval double rings.

rules.name: The Two Inks Rule
rules.body: Orange is a plate, not a paint. It fills only the primary action and the coupon stub, and otherwise appears as linework or as numerals on navy.

rules.name: The Cool Paper Rule
rules.body: Paper is cool and slightly green (security-paper). A warm cream ground breaks the world.

rules.name: The One Display Voice Rule
rules.body: Bodoni is the only display face. Italic display accents are not used.

rules.name: The Plain Zero Rule
rules.body: Figures use tabular lining numerals with an unslashed zero. This is why the sans is Archivo: Mona Sans, named in the original direction, has a slashed tabular zero.

rules.name: The Engraved Frame Rule
rules.body: Containers are framed by inset hairline rules (1px, often doubled at a 6–7px gap), never by drop shadows.

dos: Do alternate navy notes and paper sections, giving each note its inner 1px frame and microtext rule.
Do draw ornament as generated hairline guilloche (about 0.8px), and let it engrave once on arrival.
Do set every figure in tabular lining numerals that don't wrap.
Do keep the display face Bodoni and functional text Archivo, with legends at width 125%.
Do keep a human one tap away: call, WhatsApp and booking on every page.
donts: Don't use a warm cream or ivory ground.
Don't fill large areas with orange; it is reserved for the primary plate and coupon stubs.
Don't set tracked-caps labels above headings. Breadcrumbs stay sentence case.
Don't show raw stock photos; run them through the engraved vignette.
Don't loop animations or animate content into view on every section; engraving is the only motion grammar.
